description: This file defines a PHP class 'Redis' within the Opencart	hat implements caching functionalities using Redis. It provides methods to get, set, and delete cache entries with support for expiration times.
external_files: Constants: CACHE_HOSTNAME, CACHE_PORT, CACHE_PREFIX (assumed to be defined elsewhere)

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A class providing Redis cache operations including get, set, and delete within the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis client connection and sets the expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry by key and decodes the JSON data into a PHP array or value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional expiration; defaults to the class-wide expire if not provided.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.
